positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description: Joined as the first employee and helped build the company from the ground up. I led several technical efforts; most notable were data infrastructure and radar-based perception.

positions.title: Quantitative Research Engineer
positions.description: GQS (Global Quantitative Strategies) Core Data. I created and improved data pipelines, automated common workflows, and built tooling to increase productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Level 5 (Autonomous Vehicles division). I worked on mapping, simulation, research integration, and more.

honors.title: 1st Place, 2018-19 NASA USLI
honors.description: Awarded to the first place finishing team in NASA's year-long national rocketry and payload experiment competition. Our payload was a pair of autonomous, collaborative UAVs.
